serpEvidence.query: DGCA ground classes near Laxmi Nagar Delhi
serpEvidence.displayedTitle: Best Dgca ground classes in Laxmi Nagar | Aviation Training & DGCA …

liveHttpEvidence.observation: Page is live, self-canonical on the .com domain, marked index/follow, and emits LocalBusiness schema while claiming DGCA ground classes in Laxmi Nagar, flexible online/offline classes, classroom sessions, simulator practice and local training. This is not evidence those claims are true.

Homepage brands itself as We One Aviation and links to a Delhi DGCA page, an India CPL page and a Dwarka pilot-training page. It appears branded as an old/alternate We One site, but no legal entity or domain ownership evidence was found.

Returned unrelated low-quality aircraft-charter and incoherent plumbing text rather than verifiable academy contact details; possible stale, third-party or compromised content, not sufficient to determine which.
The verified .in page states that We One Aviation Academy runs DGCA ground classes in Dwarka, New Delhi.
Sitemap index comment claims “Total Indexed Pages: 268973”. This is the site's own sitemap comment, not an independent search-engine index count.

Sitemap chunk comment says 3,500 pages; visible entries mix city-targeted pilot-training routes (for example /yacuiba/pilot-training) with aircraft maintenance, aviation legal, charter and unrelated service pages under /viacha/.

conflictingBusinessDetailsInPageSchema.address: C-404, 3rd Floor, Near Ramphal Chowk Sector-7, Dwarka, New Delhi - 110075
conflictingBusinessDetailsInPageSchema.comparison: The verified .in first-party record uses PIN 110077, primary phone +91-9667370747, also publishes +91-9355566991, and uses info.weoneaviation@gmail.com. The .com page details are not assumed current or authoritative.

alternateDomainInvestigation.redirectStatus: The .com apex redirects to www for inspected URLs; no redirect to weoneaviation.in was observed.
alternateDomainInvestigation.indexingStatus: The Laxmi Nagar page appeared in a Bing SERP, is live, and is included by its self-canonical and sitemap signals; this does not independently prove Google indexing or search-engine index counts.
alternateDomainInvestigation.decision: Treat this as a potential legacy or compromised We One-branded domain, not as verified current business information. Do not attribute its LocalBusiness schema or Laxmi Nagar service claims to the verified .in entity without owner confirmation. Domain, Search Console and hosting ownership require direct verification.
